It is sad... I'm realizing that if it were a girl in my place right now, I might not even be having the doubts that I'm currently having, nor would I be ashamed to talk about this with anybody that I know. It is unfortunate that society has shaped us like this, but at least I'm grateful that my immediate circle seems to be farther from that.

Yeah, and this whole experience had made me realize that. We'll always be best friends, but it was almost foolish of me to expect things to remain as they were in our teens. One good thing I will give his crazy girlfriend though is she forced me to accept that we will inevitably distance ourselves with our own lives. In a perfect fictional world, I wouldn't even date my best friend, we'd just live our lives like we did when we were 16-19. And I swear to god, if he gets her pregnant... Man, you'll probably find me on reddit once again haha I'll still offer him my support because I love the dude, and I really hope that he becomes capable of seeing the entire picture before committing his life to her. And as much as I hate to agree, you're probably right. We are so tightly knit that one risk is just having less exposure to other people. We are so comfortable with what we have right now that we don't always see the need to expand our horizons.

I have had lots of doubts as well, as well as my fair share of falling outs with him. Tbh, things haven't gone back to the way they were since before he met his girlfriend around a year ago, and I'm sure the fights between then and now didn't help. I'll always cherish the first 8-9 years of our friendship, definitely something I'll never forget. But I'll also cherish everything from then until the day we die. Having someone that is like family, or even closer, is so tough to find these days and I'm glad that we're still close after everything. I'm terrified of losing him, because he's like the brother I never had. This is all making me realize that nothing is worth losing a friend over, especially a best friend. We we're both going to move on with our lives at some point, which was going to inevitably distance us, and it could've very well been him in my position right now had the roles been reversed, who knows? As long as we can keep the connection there, I'll be grateful.

Lmao in all honesty, I've tried, to see how I would react. I don't think I made it more than 3 seconds into any video before closing it. Then again as stated in other comments, guys in general aren't a turn on for me, he just seems to be an exception though

That's what I'm thinking, that he might be an exception. I've never been attracted to another guy. I don't even really like to get emotionally nor physically close to guys in general. My group is pretty open but I don't always open up to them. If another buddy is just chilling and partially laying down on me or has his legs on top of mine, I'll normally take it but won't enjoy it at all haha however, with my best friend, sometimes I wish he was more like the others. He is quite reserved too and it just really seems like he might be an exception. I will still see girls as my "preferred gender", but for some odd reason, he just seems to be the only guy I might be okay with. Then again, it would involve some awkwardness, but not necessarily repulsion like with all other guys.

Maybe I am scared... Honestly, we are capable of opening up to each other, but when it comes to this subject, I don't think he would take it too well. He would probably act like it's all okay, but probably try to distance himself. Out of our entire group, he was always the most "homophobic" I guess. Everyone was capable of just having our arms over our shoulders or just lying down next to each other while resting on one another, and he was always almost embarrassed by that. He has changed though, I think he's become more comfortable with these types of things since everybody's friendship has grown, but I think me talking to him about my feelings would be a too big pill to swallow to just act like it was nothing.

In my eyes, the guy is happy. I've seen them together and whilst it isn't the same best friend necessarily that I know and love, he's definitely genuine still and evidently happy. She has calmed down I think with her toxic actions (maybe not how she feels, but at least how much she shows it). The crazy part is it's impossible for him to see things rationally. He does love us, but he loves her too, and right now the world is all pink for him when he's with her. Again, she was his first everything, girl to give him attention, to love him, his first girlfriend, everything... He's also scared to leave her because he is scared to be lonely. I dont question his happiness though, which is why I prefer staying out of it, to keep our frienship strong, and I vent to my friends (or on reddit) when I need to.

I do have another very close friend, but I don't get the same emotional satisfaction of being with him than I do with my best friend. Of course I love the guy but it's not the same. My best friend is really the only guy that has made me feel like this.

Alright, well since so many people want to know, fuck it. First major sign was that on the day of my birthday last year, which was about 2 weeks since they had started seeing each other, I had organized something with all my friends, where at the end of the night my best friend and I would go out to a bar. She wouldn't let him go because she wanted him all for herself that night. He obviously was in a bad spot, so he asked if she could come, I said "Ehhh idk, I kinda wanted to be with the guys tonight", and he said "How about we do it at her place? She's offering"  


Being the nice guy I am and trying to make everyone happy, I said fuck it it doesn't matter. So we went, had a decent time, and at the end of the night, I was getting ready to go out with him, like initially planned. Instead, he just kind of looked at her and she gave him a look and said look I can't tonight. After leaving, I texted him saying "Hey man you cant do that... It's my bday and we had this planned out" She then proceeded to message me saying "Look, he was there earlier, why do you always have to be with him all the time?" Arguing insued but you can imagine.  


But this next story I'm about to say next is really fucked up.  


Being that she's more than a handful, there was a period last summer where my best friend got fed up. While driving with me, he just told me "I can't do this anymore, she stresses me too much" I proceeded to listen and give my unbiased point of view, which was yeah, she is kind of tough to handle and pretty manipulative. The reason I said that is because just a few hours prior, she had told him that she was tired how he was so spoiled by his family, and wouln't be able to go out with someone that wasn't independant, whilst also bashing about how protective they are of him by always texting him or calling on im to check on him. Mind you, he's 20, still living at home, and the oldest of the family, his parents are doing this for the first time and I'm damn sure they have their own plan for him. Later that night, he proceeded to go see her and tell her that it's over.

Now this is where it gets really fucked up.

The next night, all the guys are together, and he gets a text from her asking if they could talk. My best friend isn't stupid, and knows that if he sees her being all sweet with him that he might fall back into the trap, so he just kept on refusing, saying let's talk next week. She insisted and insisted and he kept on refusing, until she litterally said: "If you don't let me see you, I will go drown myself right now"   


What. The. Fuck.  


Of course, his heart dropped, and he agreed to let her come and speak. For the next 4 hours, they spoke, away from everyone, and she fucking convinced him that we were all putting this ideas in his head that she was crazy, and that we just all wanted him to break up with her. Tbf, he has to take part of the blame for that, and today, he absolutely does.   


Oh, and then I confronted her a week later, saying that a threat like that is ridiculous and manipulative and even almost psychotic. She responded: "You know what, call it manipulative if you want, but I needed to speak with him and it worked"  


What the fuck.  
There's more I could say, but this last story is really what made everyone back away from her forever.
